items.title: Arranging a Shared Bookshelf
items.alt: An adult in rust overalls arranges books while a child in a teal hoodie sorts another stack beside a wooden shelf.
items.description: Books fill a freestanding wooden shelf topped by a trailing plant. An adult reaches toward its rows while a seated child sorts a stack below, beside a woven basket and a strip of colored fabric.

items.title: Beaded Bookmark Beside a Closed Book
items.alt: A green hardcover book sits beside a bowl of red, black and green beads, a cord spool and a partly beaded bookmark.
items.description: A tasseled bookmark stretches across the foreground beside its remaining beads and cord. The closed green book adds a solid rectangular shape behind the small round beads and coiled spool.

items.title: Paper-Weaving Mat and Craft Tools
items.alt: A red, black, green and tan woven paper mat is surrounded by loose strips, a wooden ruler and red scissors.
items.description: Alternating paper strips form a small rectangular woven mat. Spare lengths remain beside it, with a marked wooden ruler and red scissors arranged as a compact set of craft materials.

items.title: Cloth-Wrapped Wreath with an Open Book
items.alt: A rope wreath wrapped in red, black and green fabric carries a small open book and bow at its lower edge.
items.description: Natural rope remains visible between bands of striped and geometric fabric around the circular wreath. A miniature open book rests at the bottom above a tied bow, balancing the otherwise open center.

items.title: Blank Invitation with Corn and a Wooden Cup
items.alt: A cream invitation card with a red, black and green border shows corn and a wooden cup above an ochre envelope.
items.description: A broad empty cream panel leaves the center of this invitation clear. Corn and a wooden cup decorate the lower corner, while an ochre envelope sits behind the card’s striped border.

items.title: Illustrated Gift Tags and Twine
items.alt: Three kraft gift tags show books, a woven circle and corn beside a twine spool, pencil and colored paper.
items.description: Small subject drawings distinguish the three kraft-colored tags: books, a woven circle and corn. Loose twine curves around the group, with a spool, pencil and red, black and green paper behind it.
